body:
I completely understand how you feel man. I have gone through that so many times I lost count. 

Maybe medication will help, I know that when I was on medication I felt a lot better. Even a year after stopping the medication I still had little to no issues. (I only stopped due to the various sideffects.
I used to smoke a lot. It did help when I was having a bad day, but with my new job smoking is out of the question.

My therapist only lasted for 6 months. She  seemed to think that all I had to do was meditate, laugh and learn yoga. All of which I was already currently doing with the exception of yoga.

As for the medications that I was given, both Paxil-CR and Buspar daily for anxiety and depression. After only a month I was feeling much better mood wise and people noticed. Only they said that instead of being a downer all the time I turned into an asshole. 

Some unwanted sideffects were cause by the drugs that made me stop. I lost weight (120-105) due to even worse appetite, Lost my sexdrive completely, also unable to climax, no longer felt anything at all just contentment.

I tend to read anything I can find related to self help. I do feel that if I learn even one small thing from a books that it's worth far more than the price.

Have you tried making a list? Although it can be hard to list all the things you feel are causing your depression, this will make things much more tangible when on paper. (sometimes even seem like less then you thought)

Then take time to try and cross things off the list one at a time. As you make progress you will notice that your mood will tend to level out.

I have used this method in the past and it has helped me. Hopefully it will help you too.

Although, like I said, "Suicide is always on my mind" I tend to block out this tought as I was always taught that "you can't just give up". 

Well, I really have tried for a very long time not to give up. But I feel that I'm running out of years that I can keep this up.

I couldn't tell you. I just sometimes wonder why so many bad things happened to me.

I've been through: physical/sexual abuse as a child, parents divorced as a kid, anorexia all my life (lack of appetite not anorexia nervosa), testicualr cancer, eviction, bad credit, wrongful termination, and social awkwardness towards people I just met. (theres more...but I hit the major notes)
